hypothesis: Across the complete 2,300-triple grammar formed from the 25 canonical Q80 features, adding a fixed cross-sectionally standardized pure three-way multiplicative interaction to each additive three-feature score increases mean next-target Top-5 hit share relative to its matched additive control.
estimand: For each strict-prior target, average Top-5 hit share across all 2,300 triple formulas for the interaction-enhanced score and subtract the corresponding average for the matched additive triple score; estimate chronological mean delta separately in Discovery, Validation and historical Blind OOS.

formula_universe.triple_enumeration: all unordered triples i<j<k from 25 canonical features; exhaustive within this grammar, no sampling or feature selection
formula_universe.interaction_standardization: Z40 uses mean and population standard deviation across the 40 candidate numbers for the current target's prior-only feature values; if standard deviation < 1e-12, interaction term is zero
formula_universe.ranking: descending score, deterministic tie break by ascending number 1..40
formula_universe.parameter_tuning: none; fixed operator and coefficient registered before execution

walkforward.feature_standardization: cross-sectional z-score over 40 candidate numbers, using only target-t prior-only feature values
walkforward.update_order: score all 4,600 formula variants for target t before adding target t to occurrence and pair state
walkforward.target_outcome_use: only to score already-frozen rankings; never used in feature construction or formula choice

endpoints.primary: mean target-level Top-5 hit-share delta: three-way interaction-enhanced minus matched additive family
secondary: mean target-level Top-10 hit-share delta in each split
mean target-level Top-20 hit-share delta in each split
uniform_controls: additive-family Top-5 hit share versus exact uniform expectation 0.125 in Validation and Blind OOS
interaction-family Top-5 hit share versus exact uniform expectation 0.125 in Validation and Blind OOS

baselines.matched_additive: same 2,300 feature triples without the product term

tests: interaction minus additive Top-5, Top-10 and Top-20 in each of 3 splits (9)
additive versus uniform Top-5 in Validation and Blind OOS (2)
interaction versus uniform Top-5 in Validation and Blind OOS (2)
inference.test: one-sided chronological block sign-flip, positive direction
inference.confidence_intervals: circular moving-block bootstrap, 20,000 replicates, block length 20
inference.formula_level_inference: no triple-specific p-values or selection; aggregate family summaries only

exclusions: No Q89 extension features, Q90 gate/interaction ASTs, Q7 candidate-quintet ASTs or Q92 output types.
No parameter or feature selection using Discovery, Validation or Blind OOS.
No retrospective per-target oracle or post-target formula selection.
Historical Blind OOS is exposed research history, not virgin prospective evidence.
The 2026-11-11 / contest 315 row remains excluded pending primary-source provenance resolution.
This finite three-way interaction grammar is not the full mathematical formula universe.
decision_rule: A predictive lift is not demonstrated unless the Blind OOS primary delta is positive, exceeds +0.005 Top-5 hit share, survives Holm correction, and Validation is directionally positive. Even then this historical exposed test is exploratory and cannot authorize engine promotion.
